decisive_items: positive anti–hepatitis C virus antibody status
lichenoid plaques on the right angle of mouth, bilateral buccal mucosa, and erosions covered with hemorrhagic crusts on the upper and lower lips
Dense bandlike lymphohistiocytic infiltrate in the papillary dermis
response.rationale: The combination of lichen planus symptoms and positive hepatitis C virus antibody status supports the diagnosis of Hepatitis C-associated lichen planus

rejected.why: Lack of hepatitis C virus association
Limited support from a single laboratory finding
